question_en:
The Nature Education Center plans to select pages from the 1864 "Bilder-Atlas…der Vögel" collected by the Biodiversity Heritage Library to create "Flock Observation Cards." The full range consists of colored bird plates appearing between PDF page 7 and PDF page 53. Please answer:

How many individual birds are visible on each plate? Provide a complete table of "Plate Page Number—Number of Visible Birds—Judgment." Which plates show at least three individual birds and thus need to be adapted into "Flock Observation Cards"? How many such plates are there in total?

Count only visible individual birds; birds being preyed upon are included, but snakes, mammals, text, and decorative patterns are not counted.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of "Plate Page Number—Number of Visible Birds—Judgment," followed by a Q&A section listing the page numbers of the plates requiring adaptation and the total count.
